Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

 

Who You Are

At Justworks, we’re on a mission to support and empower small and medium-sized businesses by providing a simple and friendly platform, expert support, and access to vital benefits. We believe that great design is at the heart of this mission and we’re looking for a curious, empathetic, and passionate Contract Senior Technical Writer to join our Experience Design Team. This is an exciting opportunity to craft content that is not only engaging and effective but also integral to the overall user experience.

As a Contract Senior Technical Writer, you'll work with a cross-functional team that includes product management, product marketing, operations, and customer success to document our organization's expertise and create repeatable processes that enable us to deliver excellence to our clients.

This role will require a combination of user-centricity, empathy for people facing and resolving complex challenges in a highly regulated environment, and the ability to communicate efficiently and effectively, with clarity and precision.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating the intake of knowledge from subject matter expert stakeholders. You will lead interviews (in-person and virtual), ask the right questions, and produce the documentation that captures those SME's expertise.

 

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

  • Gain an understanding of Justworks' products and services
  • Develop discussion guides and other artifacts to guide stakeholder discussions
  • Engage with cross-functional SMEs and manage scheduling for intake sessions
  • Create user-friendly documentation of processes and workflows
  • Write, edit, and review documentation to maintain a high level of quality
  • Follow internal accepted standards for style, structure, and tone
  • Oversee and contribute to the work of other writers and knowledge professionals
  • Perform other related responsibilities as needed based on department and/or organizational needs.

How You Will Do Your Work

As a Contract Senior Technical Writer, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following:

  • Demonstrated ability to create high-quality written knowledge content
  • Ability to make complicated processes understandable
  • Understanding of contemporary practices for creating content that is accessible, usable, and well-structured
  • Ability to engage stakeholders in knowledge-gathering interviews and follow-up communication.
  • Ability to manage the work of one or more other writers
  • Ability to work as part of a mulit-disciplinary design team
  • Willingness to pivot when needed to accommodate shifting priorities.  

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

  • Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
  • Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
  • Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
  • Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. 
  • Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience in editorial content writing, knowledge management, or journalism
  • A portfolio of work or similar samples of relevant writing
  • A background in journalism (or similar expository writing) is preferred
  • This role is a hybrid remote / in-person at our New York City office. Please expect to be in the office 2-3 days a week.

This is a fixed term contract role for 6 months. This position is paid on an hourly basis, at a rate of  $80-100 per hour, depending on experience. 

#Hybrid #LI-DW1

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks. 

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.

About the role We’re looking for a Content Designer to join OpenAI’s Content Design team, bringing deep expertise in prompt engineering and AI evaluation alongside strong content design craft and product judgment. You’ll combine editorial judgment, product strategy, and technical implementation to build prompts, evaluations, and tools that help us create and improve content and messaging at scale. About the Developer Experience team

The Developer Experience (DevX) team owns how developers learn and build on Together AI. We run the documentation site, API reference, quickstarts, cookbooks, and the tooling that keeps all of it accurate as the platform ships new models and features every week.

We treat docs as a product and as code. Content lives in Git, publishes through Mintlify, and stays in sync with the API through CI/CD automation built on GitHub Actions. We also write for two audiences at once: the human developer reading a guide, and the AI coding agent pulling our docs into its context window. That means a house style guide built for AI-assisted authoring, structured content agents can parse, and automated review passes that check drafts against our quality bar.

Role Overview

As a Technical Writer Intern on DevX, you will write, test, and ship documentation that thousands of developers use to build with open-weight models. You'll be paired with a DevX mentor and own significant projects end to end, from scoping through launch, with real users and real metrics at the finish line. 

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll run the code you document, call our APIs, and open pull requests against the docs repo from your first week.

Potential projects include:

  • Build a closed-to-open migration kit
  • Make a docs section agent-ready, and prove it
  • Generate the CLI reference from source
  • Write an evaluation design tutorial series

Responsibilities

  • Write clear, accurate guides, tutorials, and reference content for Together AI's inference, fine-tuning, and GPU cluster products.
  • Work with engineers, product managers, and researchers to understand new features well enough to explain them simply.
  • Use AI tools in your daily workflow, and help us improve how we use them for drafting, editorial review, and publishing.
  • Test every feature you document by running the code yourself, and file bugs when the product or the docs don't behave as expected.
  • Draft, review, and publish in a docs-as-code workflow: Git, pull requests, code review, and Mintlify.
  • Contribute to release notes and changelog entries as features launch.
  • Use page analytics, search data, and developer feedback to decide what to improve next.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field, graduating December 2027 or later.
  • Exceptional written communication: you can make a complex technical idea clear and approachable.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language (Python or TypeScript preferred) and comfort with Git source control.
  • Curiosity about how developers learn, and how AI is changing the way they do it.

Nice to have

  • Experience calling an LLM API or building a small project with AI tools.
  • Familiarity with Markdown/MDX, static site generators, or docs platforms like Mintlify or Docusaurus.
  • Experience with CI tools such as GitHub Actions.

Writing sample

Your application should include one or two writing samples, representing what you think is your own best work. The subject doesn’t have to be technical, or even nonfiction—though both are a plus! For example:

  • A technical blog post.
  • A README, tutorial, or contribution to open-source docs.
  • A research paper.
  • A personal essay.
  • A school newspaper submission.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details: 

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span either May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $41 a hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Knowledge Manager, you will be tasked with owning the knowledge strategy for SentinelOne's Global Support organization. This is a senior individual contributor role, not people management. Based in Costa Rica, you will work closely with Support, TAM, Product, and the teams building our AI-driven support tools, making sure the knowledge base is accurate, current, and structured well enough to power both human agents and AI assistants like FIN and Support Genie.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own the technical knowledge base end to end, including content strategy, taxonomy, quality standards, and the full content lifecycle from creation and review to retirement.
  • Partner with Support Engineers and Escalation Managers to turn resolved cases, recurring issues, and technical insights into high-quality KB articles, how-to guides, and troubleshooting content.
  • Structure and tag knowledge content to ensure it can be effectively consumed by our AI-powered support tools, as well as easily accessed by our teams.
  • Establish a regular audit and gap analysis process, using case data, search trends, and deflection metrics to identify missing, outdated, or underperforming content.
  • Define, track, and report on key knowledge base health metrics, including coverage, freshness, usage, and deflection impact.
  • Train and coach frontline and backline Support Engineers on knowledge contribution standards, best practices, and workflows.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Documentation teams to align Support knowledge with official product documentation and ensure consistency across knowledge sources.
  • Support the integration and rollout of new knowledge sources into the broader Support knowledge ecosystem.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Proven experience building or scaling a technical knowledge management program, ideally in a support or SaaS environment.
  • Excellent written communication; you can turn a messy case resolution into a clear, reusable article.
  • Comfort working with data to prioritize what to write next and prove impact.
  • Experience partnering across Support, Engineering, and Product Management.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted support tools (chatbots, copilots, RAG-based search) and what makes content usable by them.
  • Self-starter who can operate with significant autonomy at a senior IC level.
  • An authoritative and assertive approach, with a strong ability to drive execution.
  • Technical training and coaching skills, along with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work hybrid, with 2 days per week onsite.
  • Strong technical background across endpoint, cloud, or network security is a plus; coding and scripting skills are also a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Private medical, dental, and vision insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Global home office allowance
  • Internet or mobile phone allowance
  • Hybrid work model with flexible hours

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness programs

Growth & Community

  • In-office lunch program

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Monks is a global, digital-first marketing, technology, and creative consultancy operating at the intersection of creativity, media, data, and culture. In APAC, our 700-strong team spans 14 offices across 11 countries, connected by a single, unified operating model.

As pioneers in the AI digital media economy, we live an AI-first culture internally while helping enterprise clients shift from manual workflows to AI-native orchestration — scaling custom agent solutions (Monks.Flow), AI-driven campaigns, and next-gen AI search capabilities. By connecting brand strategy, media, data, and emerging technology around the consumer, we build intelligent platforms and content ecosystems for the world's leading brands. The Role

Monks is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Writer / Editor to join a regional creative team producing rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Working in close partnership with client stakeholders and a distributed global team, this role will refine complex technical material into clear, engaging content for consumer-facing audiences who are already comfortable with technology.

This role is primarily focused on editing and adapting approved source content rather than writing technical narratives from scratch. The ideal candidate can improve clarity, structure and tone without diluting technical meaning, introducing inaccuracies or oversimplifying the subject matter.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.

  • Edit and refine technical editorial and marketing content for clarity, accuracy, flow and audience relevance.
  • Preserve essential technical meaning while making complex information accessible and engaging.
  • Adapt approved source copy across web, social, video, presentation and other digital formats.
  • Create copy variants based on platform requirements, audience needs, character limits and established messaging.
  • Develop and refine headlines, subheads, summaries, captions, calls to action and on-screen copy.
  • Apply approved copy within design layouts, working closely with designers to balance meaning, hierarchy and available space.
  • Partner with subject matter experts to clarify technical details and resolve gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Work with producers to track copy status, approvals, source material and open questions.
  • Consolidate editorial feedback and recommend resolutions when comments are subjective, conflicting or unclear.
  • Maintain established terminology, naming conventions, voice and editorial standards.

  • Document approved language, recurring feedback and editorial decisions for future use.

  • Use approved AI and editorial tools to support research, comparison, versioning and efficiency while maintaining human editorial judgment.
  • Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical editing, technical writing, technology journalism, digital publishing or editorial marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to edit complex technology content without losing accuracy or nuance.
  • Experience writing for technically fluent consumer, professional or business audiences.
  • Strong understanding of digital editorial structure, information hierarchy and platform-specific copy requirements.
  • Experience adapting a single source narrative into multiple formats and copy variants.
  • Exceptional command of written English, grammar, syntax and editorial style is required.
  • Strong proofreading, fact-checking and self-QA skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously, manage rapid turnarounds and make sound editorial decisions amid ambiguity.
  • Confidence collaborating with technical experts, designers, motion artists, producers and senior stakeholders.

About the Role

Developer relations is evolving quickly. Coding agents, informed by reference architectures and machine-readable documentation, are increasingly making integration decisions on behalf of developers. And trust, transparency, and human interaction are more important than ever as open source ideals and corporate agendas are weirdly attacked, limited, or promoted by unexpected sources and trends.

Backblaze B2 Cloud storage was launched as a result of developer demand and has been committed to the developer ecosystem since day one. Today, we are seeking a leader who can help us become more present and trusted than ever before in this space, both as the storage default for agent-led projects and as a leading source of support, inspiration, and enablement for developers who need storage for whatever they’re building.

As Sr. Developer Relations Manager, you'll work across a strong set of existing assets — a mature docs team, an engineering team focused on AI ecosystem integrations, our Flamethrower Startup Program, a content org, and an outward-facing SE team — and coordinate their outputs into a coherent, credible developer presence that earns mindshare where it matters most.

This is a program-defining role for someone who thinks in systems, works backwards from adoption goals, knows how to make a company technically credible with developers who haven't heard of it yet, and is comfortable both channeling and being the face of developer relationships at Backblaze.

 

What You'll Own

Developer Presence in the Agentic Stack

The primary goal of this role is to ensure Backblaze B2 is the best storage layer for developers and for their agents. That means understanding how AI coders discover and evaluate infrastructure tools today: through MCP servers, coding agent contexts, reference architectures, SDKs, and machine-readable documentation. You'll work with the internal AI team to define what "agent-ready" means for Backblaze and drive execution against it across engineering, docs, and content.

 

Cross-Functional Coordination

This role starts as an individual contributor, but you'll have real influence over a strong set of resources: an engineering team building integrations into AI tooling (MLFlow, ComfyUI, Hugging Face, popular agent frameworks), a docs team that can be directed toward structured, agent-consumable formats, a content org that can amplify what you build, and an SE team that can extend your enablement work, among a number of others at the company. Your job is to coordinate these teams around a unified developer strategy, keep that strategy moving, and share its outputs with the broader world.

 

Community and Ecosystem

Developers trust other developers. You'll underscore Backblaze's credibility in the communities where AI builders live: GitHub, Discord, open source projects, developer events, and the growing ecosystem of AI infrastructure tooling. You'll elevate internal technical voices, use their expertise to build your own thought leadership in the space, and partner with ecosystem players, and show up in a way that is earned, not marketed. Critically, you should have a presence in this community before coming to the role.

 

Developer Feedback Loop

You'll maintain a tight feedback loop from the developer community back to product and engineering — surfacing adoption friction, unmet integration needs, and emerging patterns worth prioritizing. The Flamethrower Startup Program gives you direct access to early-stage builders who can serve as signal-rich canaries for what's working and what isn't.

 

Metrics and Program Accountability

You'll define what success looks like — developer signups, activation rates, B2 adoption in AI frameworks, community engagement, content reach — and own progress against it. We're building this program to drive real revenue, and you'll be expected to connect the dots between awareness and conversion. Success in this role opens the door to bringing on, or from elsewhere in the company, developer resources to grow the program.

  • Worked, or started, without a large team. You know how to amplify yourself through cross-functional relationships, external partners, and community rather than headcount.
  • Strong communicator — to developers externally and to leadership internally. You can write a crisp technical tutorial and a clear exec summary with equal ease.
  • Existing presence in developer communities. A following, conference talks, open source contributions, a technical blog — some signal that developers pay attention when you show up.

 

Strong plus:

  • Familiarity with how coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) surface and recommend infrastructure tools
  • Experience working with or building on top of open source frameworks in the AI/ML ecosystem (MLflow, DVC, Ray Data, WebDataset, and MosaicML Streaming)

Developers are making storage decisions earlier in the stack than ever before — often before they've spoken to a salesperson, often through a coding agent recommending a reference architecture. Backblaze has the right product, the right price point, and a growing engineering investment behind this motion. What we need is the person who can translate that into developer conviction at scale.

In this role you’ll take a responsive approach to software documentation problems and develop a strong understanding of how products work together and are used in the real world.   

An operations-focused Technical Author is part of a business team, for example Legal, HR or Talent. An important part of this work is to maintain internal documentation, such as employee handbooks. The Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge Architecture will help establish and evolve the emerging discipline of content engineering—designing, structuring, delivering, and managing content so it’s strategic, scalable, consumable across surfaces, and efficiently adjusted, rather than a collection of one-off articles or chunks—within our organization.
